scope: Expanded price/lease history, illustrative asset/debt/equity cash flows, primary-source trace and three-language HTML.
findings: 451 research observations cover 15 types in four segments (3/4/4/4); 180 AVAC cells, 249 chart readings and 22 printed-number observations.
All AVAC cells were independently read using an alternate table parser; all 249 chart points were checked with an alternate PDF extraction method and visual calibration.

The eight main historical SVGs contain 160 new-aircraft points, 108 comparable-series edges and four published-range bars per language. Ages, source families and technical bases are not silently joined.
All 53 independent cash-flow checks pass: asset NPV, month-end and advance rent, amortizing debt and terminal balloon, equity IRR, sensitivities, depreciation and first-year profit/cash flow.
The final RU/EN/DE tables, numerical examples and source/navigation anchors pass. Browser visual layout review is owned by the parent agent.
limitations: Chart-derived values are approximate readings, not published market uncertainty bounds; no false precision or interpolation through missing years is implied.
Appraisal definitions, age bands and aircraft configurations vary. Cross-source curves are not one homogeneous price index; gross rent/value is not net yield.
All lease-economics inputs are explicit hypothetical assumptions, not an observed commercial deal or an investment recommendation.
The data remain research-only and are not automatically imported into the production calculator.

reproduction.data_audit_dependencies: pandas 2.2.3; price-history PDF audit also uses pdfplumber/pdfminer
reproduction.raw_cache_location: outside repository; supplied explicitly to independent verification scripts

final_html_refresh: Numerical/static audits rerun after horizontal chart wrappers and four-year demand x-axis labels; source data and previous source audits unchanged.
